title: ProFORMA: Probabilistic Feature-based On-line Rapid Model Acquisition
summary: A three-minute demo of ProFORMA, a system from Cambridge that builds textured 3D models live from a video of an object.
why: HN cites it as an early demo of generating 3D models just by filming an object, in threads on Kinect, 3D printing and depth cameras.

quote.text: this demo is showing 3D generation by just filming the object
